profile_candidate.scope: Synthetic FHIR input/response minimization and stdio audit tests; no real PHI, clinical backend or HIPAA certification.

access-boundary.claim: Only registered read tools with validated inputs are accepted; stdio identity is a documented placeholder.

data-exposure.claim: FHIR responses are minimized and patient identifiers are HMAC-hashed in audit records.

untrusted-instructions.claim: Untrusted FHIR response shapes are rejected rather than becoming tool authority.

consequential-actions.claim: Invalid tool requests are refused and audited before handler execution.

evidence-lineage.claim: Success and failure invocations have a bounded audit record with request context.

bounded-claims.claim: The source keeps synthetic-only and production-stub limitations explicit.

access-boundary.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

data-exposure.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

untrusted-instructions.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

consequential-actions.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

evidence-lineage.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

bounded-claims.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

remaining_gaps: The verify job is a coarse CI gate. Document review is not automated proof. SMART OAuth/KMS stubs, real clinical authorization and semantic injection resistance remain outside this evidence.
